quarterly_data.quarter: Honeywell press release: Honeywell Technologies Completes Sale of Warehouse and (07-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Honeywell Technologies completed the sale of its Warehouse and Workflow Solutions (WWS) business, which operates commercially under the Intelligrated and Transnorm brands, to American Industrial Partners (AIP) in an all-cash transaction (announced Jul. 27, 2026); the sale of its Productivity Solutions and Services business was then expected to close in early August of 2026. CEO Vimal Kapur: the WWS divestiture further sharpens Honeywell Technologies as a pure-play automation company focused on the Building, Industrial and Process end markets.
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: buyer of the Warehouse and Workflow Solutions business
